remarks:
Get ready to fall in love with this warm and inviting Classic Colonial situated on 1.11 acres in a highly desirable Lancaster location. This timeless and impressive property offers exceptional space, tranquility and quality construction.

A true standout of this home is the spectacular radiant-heated, year-round sunroom, surrounded by expansive windows and highlighted by the soaring vaulted ceilings. This incredible space with picturesque views offers approximately 560 additional sq. ft.—ideal for relaxing or entertaining in every season. Step outside to your own private retreat featuring an in-ground gunite pool and hot tub, all set against a serene wooded backdrop with no rear neighbors—perfect for tranquil outdoor living.

The impressive 3,382 sq. ft. interior features a stunning great room with vaulted ceiling, skylights and fireplace, along with a formal living room, formal dining room and private den/office that could easily serve as a fourth bedroom. Upstairs, you’ll find a well-appointed primary en-suite, two additional generously sized bedrooms and a large loft offering flexible living space. The inviting and spacious layout offers wonderful versatility for both everyday living and entertaining.

Additional highlights include beautiful hardwood floors, well-maintained mechanicals, a whole-house generator and security system, providing an outstanding foundation to make this home your own. Lovingly cared for by the original family, this property was held in a life estate and is being offered in its present condition, sellers will make no repairs or improvements as a result of home inspection or appraisal. Experience the perfect blend of space, quality, privacy and elevated living in this truly special Lancaster home.
